messages.ko: 이제 명절이네ㅔ~~ 즐거운 시간 보내구ㅜ 푹쉬다 만나쟈
messages.en: It's the holiday now~~ Have a good timeㅜ and get plenty of rest before we meet again.
I just ate my mom's kimchi-jjim too~
After continuously having schedules without staying overnight,
when I finally came home to my comfortable house,
I was even dozing off while eating ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
I'm seriously losing it.
I was filming
and took a really nasty fall,
so I'm practically a mummy right now.
I was running and got
scraped up on the asphalt,
and even though it hurt like crazy,
I fell in such a ridiculously funny way.
The members said I looked like some frozen tuna,
and that they thought I was diving.

messages.ko: 넘어지는 영상도 있는데 그거 보면서 계속 웃고!!!!
messages.en: There's even a video of me falling, and they kept laughing while watching it!!!!
A few seconds after I fell,
when I opened my eyes,
all the members were surrounding me and looking down at me,
I couldn't feel the pain, only the embarrassment.
And I remember.
The moment I fell there that day.
The faces of those who laughed.
Write them in the Death Note.
I will.

messages.ko: 활어회가 어쩌다 냉동참치까지 된 거야 아이구ㅜㅜ왜 다치고 그래 바부야 신경 쓰이게ㅜㅜ
messages.en: How did live sashimi end up becoming frozen tuna? Aigooㅜㅜ Why did you have to get hurt, you dummy, making me worryㅜㅜ
I guess I got frozen. Maybe it's because the weather is cold.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅎㅋㅎㅌ
But I
didn't cry.
Amazing, right?
You'll get a present from Santa Claus~ ㅋㅋ
Oh yeah!!
If I fall and cry,
it hurts my pride.
I'm a woman who lives and dies by her pride.
I brushed myself off and got back up,
pretending like nothing happened,
but the moment I saw blood,
I almost cried.

messages.ko: 나 또 상여자라 눈물은 인생에서 3번만 흘림
messages.en: But I'm a real tough woman, so I only cry three times in my life.
But seriously, I can't let this scar.
My entire left shoulder and arm are scraped up,
and my knee is completely scraped up too.
Legendary, right?
Since I can't let it scar,
Y/n, give up your vacation and come over
and put medicine on it for me…
Should I blow on it beside you 24 hours a day??
If you blow on it for 24 hours, you'll die first.
Still, this time
I'll rest at my family's home
together with Geumbi
and have a fun time.

messages.ko: 금비 산책 잘 시켜줘 넘어지지 말고..
messages.en: Take good care of Geumbi on walks, and don't fall..
If I fall again while taking her for a walk,
then there's seriously something going on this year.
But I told you,
I have a superpower for recovering.
Ah, this is real ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋㅋ
I recover faster than other people.
Even when I get hurt the same way, I always heal first,
this is really true,
but I can't prove it.
Didn't a spider bite you??!
Ha… I wasn't going to say this,

messages.ko: 사실 나 Y/n집 벽에 붙어있었어 방금
messages.en: but actually, I was just stuck to the wall of Y/n's house.
I came home again,
and it was nice seeing you KakaoTalking while smiling.
I sprayed some F-Killer.
Ah, was that what you sprayed outside earlier?
I thought it was mist,
but my eyes did sting.

messages.ko: 에프킬라 맞고 괜찮은거보면 확실히 회복 초능력 있긴하네
messages.en: Seeing that you're fine after getting sprayed with F-Killer, you really do have a recovery superpower.
No one can stop me.
I'll use something like F-Killer as mist!!!!
음하하ㅏㅏ!!!!!!
You sound like someone who isn't hurt at all right now.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
I guess my fingers are fine, at least.
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋThen you really just have to make sure you don't fall by yourself ㅋㅋㅋ

messages.ko: 아니 요즘 내가 진짜 거미로 진화하는 시기라 그런가
messages.en: No, maybe it's because I'm really in the process of evolving into a spider these days.
My powers weren't working for a moment.

messages.ko: 평소같았으면 시간 딱 뒤로 돌리기 해서 막았을텐데
messages.en: Normally, I would've just turned back time and stopped it.
Like Doctor Strange.
Tracer, what a shame.
No, recently
I watched all the Overwatch cinematics,
and I even bought a skin.
The Ghost Omnic skin.
I didn't spend any money on it though,
but what's really unfair is
why does Mercy have so many pretty skins?
Bastion barely has any pretty ones.
It's because he's ugly..
But Roadhog has a lot of cute skins too??
During this holiday,
I should level up a bit.
Come in.
Let's play this together too, like Roblox.
ㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
Try to guess my username.
Isn't it that? That giant fluorescent tank thing?
I used that during PC Bang Signal,
and if a Bastion using the Ghost Omnic
gets first place in damage?
You can assume that's me.

messages.ko: 근데 너 로블록스 어떻게 해? 얼굴인증 18살 넘었다고? 10살 같은데
messages.en: But how do you play Roblox? Did you verify your face as being over 18? You look like you're 10.
Oh right.
Today during waiting time,
I played Roblox too,
and I had all the members install Among Us,
so we played Among Us too.
I went around kindly explaining the rules too.
Maybe because I made the room,
I kept getting Impostor over and over.
It was pretty thrilling.
I'm so good at this.
I killed someone right in front of Kim ChaeWon,
and I said Kim ChaeWon did it,

messages.ko: 다 내말 들어서 김채원이 죽음 ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
messages.en: and everyone listened to me, so Kim ChaeWon got killed ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
케케키킼키케케케케케케케케케케키키키키키킼
I was sitting right next to Jeong HyeRin,
so we turned away from each other so we couldn't see each other's screens,
but Jeong HyeRin and I kept getting Impostor together,
so without even turning our phones,

messages.ko: 거의 대놓고 사보타주 거는법 알려주고 했는데도
messages.en: we practically openly showed each other how to sabotage,
and nobody noticed.
And the exciting part was
Nien unnie was playing for the first time,
and she got Impostor with me,

messages.ko: 눈치껏 내가 킬 하니까 바로 킬 해줘서
messages.en: and when I made a kill, she picked up on it and immediately made a kill too,
so we won with a double kill.
We really need to make self-produced content where we play games.
I can do it really well, like a YouTuber.

messages.ko: 예능반장 수민이 있으니까 게임반장 하연이 하자
messages.en: Since Soomin is the variety show class president, let's make Hayeon the game class president.
Are you going to make me class president for the first time in my life?

messages.ko: 반장이라 함은 저에게 있어서 굉장히 트라우마인데도
messages.en: Being class president is quite traumatic for me,
but if you make me one, I'll do my best.
A lot of people don't know this story.
To summarize,

messages.ko: 친구의 추천으로 반장선거에 나가게된 하연이 부푼 꿈을 않고 출마했지만 결과는 1표만 나왔고 그 한표도 제가 한것입니다…
messages.en: Hayeon ran for class president because a friend recommended her, full of big dreams, but the result was only one vote, and that one vote was mine…

messages.ko: 그 친구는 날 왜 추천했을지 아직도 의문이고요
messages.en: I still wonder why that friend recommended me.
Let's add that friend's name to the Death Note.
I don't remember their name, so consider yourself lucky.
What was your strategy? I'm so curious.
But I did it in a pretty predictable way.
I should've made it more fun ㅋ
Was it 'I will make a clean class'?
Wow, that's right.

messages.ko: 깨끗한 반! 최고의 반!을 만들겠~습니다~ 감사~합니다~
messages.en: I'll make a clean class! The best class! Thank~ you~
Something like that.
You know that tone kids use when presenting in elementary school.
You have to keep raising the pitch here and there.
Did I tell you that story before?
When I was in elementary school,
the story about getting scolded because of a pencil.
No, this was really funny.
I think it was during math class.
The teacher wrote a problem on the board
and said, 'Anyone who knows this, come up and answer it.'

messages.ko: 당연히 아는문제라 생각해서 손을 번쩍 들었지
messages.en: I thought it was obviously a problem I knew, so I raised my hand high.
But I was the only one who raised my hand.
I was about to answer proudly,
but I thought it was addition, and it was multiplication or something.
I don't know, it was a harder problem than I thought.
I could've just said I saw it wrong and put my hand down,
but I was so embarrassed
and I was holding a pencil in the hand I'd raised,

messages.ko: 엇 제가 든게 아니라 연필이 말하고 싶다고해서요.
messages.en: so I said, 'Oh, it wasn't me who raised it, the pencil wanted to say something.'
I said something like that.
I can't believe I did that.
The teacher said, 'If you don't know, just say you don't know!!!'
The sound of the kids laughing at me back then
is still vivid to this day.
You should've written them in the Death Note.
How many people am I supposed to write in the Death Note already?
I need to buy a new one.
But I think that pose was really embarrassing.
Holding the pencil up between my thumb and index finger,
saying, 'The pencil raised its hand, though?'
Recreate that pose when you go live later.
I'll really show you.
And since I was sitting near the front,
the kids behind me
must have seen my pencil-holding hand and my stiff back,
which is so embarrassing.

messages.ko: 그럼 살면서 제일 수치스러웠던 적이 그 날이야?ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
messages.en: Then was that the most embarrassing moment of your life?ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
No, there's more.
In the school bathroom, while looking in the mirror,
I was pretending to film YouTube,
or maybe pretending to film an advertisement,
anyway, I thought nobody was there
and was talking to myself,

messages.ko: 칸에서 누가 나와서 나 쳐다보고 나감
messages.en: when someone came out of a stall, looked at me, and walked away.
That was legendary.
I think I was in middle school.
It felt like someone had discovered my other self.

messages.ko: 얼마나 창피했으면 왜이렇게 디테일하게 기억하고 있는거야
messages.en: It must've been so embarrassing if you remember it in this much detail.
I'll never forget this.
Hasn't there been anything recently??ㅋㅋ
Recently, the frozen tuna incident is the most embarrassing.

messages.ko: 진짜 모든 멤버와 감독님과 매니지먼트분들 다 몰려와서
messages.en: Seriously, all the members, the director, and the management staff came rushing over
and stood around me
in a circle, looking down at me from above.
I literally couldn't see the sky.
Seriously ㅋㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋ
If I had just fallen and that was it,

messages.ko: 심지어 우리뛰는거 다 찍고있고 영상도 남아서
messages.en: but they were filming us running, so there's even footage of it,
and everyone kept coming up to me

messages.ko: 아프겠다… 근데 너 넘어지는 영상 봤어?
messages.en: saying, 'That must hurt… but did you see the video of you falling?'
while trying not to laugh.
But I really did fall in a funny way.
The really funny thing is
I didn't trip over anything,
my legs just suddenly gave out,
and I scrambled around trying not to fall,
then fell almost like I was jumping with my last bit of strength,
so I really looked like a fish.
Don't imagine it.
My skin is sliced up like beef brisket right now,
and all I get in return is ridicule.

messages.ko: 그렇게 회를 좋아하더니 기어이 스스로 횟감까지 돼 버리다니...너무 매력적이자너
messages.en: You liked sashimi so much that you ended up becoming sashimi yourself... that's so charming.
Oh, I'm charming?
Then that's fine.

messages.ko: Y/n 웃길수 있다면 난 한번더 굴러줄수 있어
messages.en: If I can make Y/n laugh, I can roll around one more time.
Did Y/n go to their family's home?
Get plenty of rest and eat lots of delicious food.
Live thumbnail
Have a good holiday~
I'll take a picture of Geumbi and post it~
Haranghae😏❤️❤️
